chunks_retrieved.title: Resolution
chunks_retrieved.text: After verification the customer gets a free replacement or a full refund, including delivery fees. No reverse pickup fee applies.

chunks_retrieved.title: Reverse pickup and fees
chunks_retrieved.text: Returns are collected from the delivery address through reverse pickup. A reverse pickup fee of ₹49 applies to change-of-mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags. The fee is waived for ZentroMart Plus members and for any item returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.

chunks_retrieved.title: Condition of returned items
chunks_retrieved.text: Items must be unused, with original tags, packaging, accessories and free gifts. Beauty and personal care products are returnable only if unopened with the seal intact. Electronics must not be physically damaged, and any screen lock or account lock must be removed.

chunks_retrieved.title: Booking
chunks_retrieved.text: Raise the return from My Orders. Choose a pickup slot. The delivery executive will check the item at the door against the condition rules in RET-4.
